title: Stream Read
text: Stream data from shared memory to processor algorithms, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Output data type} sets Data type of IP core; {Device name} sets the name of IP core, {Samples per frame} sets the size of data vector read from IP core, {Number of buffers} sets the number of data buffers, {Enable event-based execution} enables event-driven task execution and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Data frame from shared memory vector

ports.name: done
ports.summary: Notification message of completed read scalar

params.name: Device name
params.values: Name of IP core device ip:s2mm0 (default) | colon-separated list of IP core name and channel

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of IP core uint32 (default) | uint16 | uint64 | fixdt(0,128,0)

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Size of data vector read from IP core 1024 (default) | positive scalar integer

params.name: Number of buffers
params.values: Number of data buffers 16 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable event-based execution
params.values: Enable event-driven task execution on (default) | off

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in seconds -1 (default) | positive scalar
